Filter parameter একটি API-এর সবচেয়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত অংশ — প্রায় প্রতিটি list endpoint-এ category, status, date range, price range থাকে। কিন্তু QA checklist-এ filtering প্রায়ই surface level-এ থেমে যায়: "filter দিলাম, data আসল" — এটুকু দেখেই pass।

Production-এ filtering bug silent killer। User "Electronics" filter select করলেও Books দেখলে immediately trust হারায়। আরো dangerous — filter leak: sensitive data অন্য role-এর filter bypass করে expose হওয়া। Sorting বা pagination-এর মতো filtering-ও isolated test করলে half coverage — real world-এ filter + sort + pagination + search একসাথে কাজ করে।

নিচে Filtering API-এর জন্য একটি সম্পূর্ণ, production-ready test suite দেওয়া হলো। সব test case text format-এ — code block ছাড়াই, professional QA documentation style-এ। Technical terms English-এ রাখা হয়েছে।

---

Filtering API বুঝে নেওয়া — Test শুরু করার আগে

API filtering সাধারণত query parameter দিয়ে implement হয়। Common pattern:

  • Exact match: category=electronics
  • Range filter: minPrice=100&maxPrice=500
  • Multi-value: category=electronics,books বা category[]=electronics&category[]=books
  • Date range: from=2026-01-01&to=2026-06-30
  • Boolean: isActive=true
  • Search + filter: search=phone&category=electronics

Test suite শুরু করার আগে API documentation থেকে confirm করুন: filter logic AND নাকি OR, case sensitivity, default behavior, invalid value handling — assumption-এ test লিখলে false result হবে।

Filter Type উদাহরণ সাধারণ সমস্যা
Enum / Categorystatus=activeInvalid enum silent pass, filter leak
Numeric RangeminPrice, maxPriceBoundary inclusive/exclusive confusion
Date Rangefrom, toTimezone off-by-one, null end date
Multi-valuetags=red,blueAND vs OR logic undocumented
Role-basedImplicit tenant filterCross-tenant data leak
---

Single Filter Test Cases

প্রতিটি supported filter field-এর জন্য minimum একটি positive test — returned data সব item-এ filter condition satisfy করে কিনা verify করুন।

TC-FILTER-001: Category Filter — Exact Match

Endpoint: GET /api/products?category=electronics

Expected Result: Status 200 OK। Response-এর প্রতিটি item-এ category = "electronics"। অন্য category-র product একটিও leak হবে না — এটাই filtering-এর primary assertion।

TC-FILTER-002: Price Range Filter

Query: minPrice=100&maxPrice=500

Expected Result: সব returned product-এ price 100 থেকে 500-এর মধ্যে — boundary inclusive/exclusive API spec অনুযায়ী। minPrice=100 item include হবে, maxPrice=500 item include হবে (inclusive হলে)।

TC-FILTER-003: Status Filter — Active Only

Query: status=active

Expected Result: শুধু active product return। Inactive, draft, archived — কোনো item response-এ থাকবে না।

TC-FILTER-004: Status Filter — Inactive

Query: status=inactive

Expected Result: শুধু inactive item। Active item leak হবে না। Admin-only filter হলে unauthorized user-এ 403।

TC-FILTER-005: Boolean Filter

Query: isFeatured=true

Expected Result: শুধু featured item return। isFeatured=false item mixed হবে না।

TC-FILTER-006: Date Range Filter

Query: from=2026-01-01&to=2026-03-31

Expected Result: createdAt (বা documented date field) Q1 2026-এর মধ্যে — January 1 থেকে March 31। February বা April record overflow হবে না। Timezone documented behavior অনুযায়ী।

TC-FILTER-007: Case-Insensitive Filter

Query: category=Electronics (uppercase E)

Expected Result: category=electronics-এর same result — case sensitivity spec অনুযায়ী। Case-insensitive claim থাকলে verify; sensitive হলে different result documented।

TC-FILTER-008: Brand / Vendor Filter

Query: brand=samsung

Expected Result: শুধু Samsung brand item। Slug vs display name mismatch-এ empty result acceptable — wrong data acceptable নয়।

---

Multi-Value & Combination Filter Tests

TC-FILTER-009: Multiple Category — OR Logic

Query: category=electronics,books

Expected Result: Electronics অথবা Books — যেকোনো একটি category-র item (OR logic)। Documentation-এ OR specify থাকলে verify; AND হলে item উভয় category satisfy করতে হবে — rare but documented হতে পারে।

TC-FILTER-010: Multiple Filters — AND Logic

Query: category=electronics&status=active&minPrice=200

Expected Result: তিনটি condition একসাথে satisfy — electronics AND active AND price >= 200। যেকোনো একটি fail করলে item exclude।

TC-FILTER-011: Overlapping Range Filters

Query: minPrice=100&maxPrice=300&minRating=4

Expected Result: Price range এবং rating — দুটোই apply। Item শুধু price match করে rating fail করলে exclude।

TC-FILTER-012: Filter + Search Combined

Query: search=phone&category=electronics

Expected Result: Search term match এবং category electronics — দুটো condition। Search result-এ non-electronics item থাকবে না।

TC-FILTER-013: Filter + Sort Combined

Query: category=books&sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: শুধু books, price ascending-এ sorted। Filtered subset-এ sort order correct।

TC-FILTER-014: Filter + Pagination

Query: category=electronics&page=2&pageSize=10

Expected Result: Page 2 of electronics products — প্রতিটি page-এ filter consistently apply। Page 1 এবং Page 2-তে non-electronics item zero। Total count filtered count reflect করবে।

TC-FILTER-015: Filter + Sort + Pagination — Triple Combo

Query: status=active&minPrice=500&sort=createdAt&order=desc&page=1&pageSize=20

Expected Result: Active, price >= 500, newest first, first 20 item। Metadata total filtered total match।

---

Negative & Validation Test Cases

TC-FILTER-016: Non-Existent Category

Query: category=nonexistentcategory

Expected Result: Status 200 OK, empty array, total: 0। 404 বা 500 acceptable নয় — empty filter result error নয়।

TC-FILTER-017: Invalid Numeric Filter Value

Query: minPrice=abc

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "minPrice must be a number." Silent ignore করে full dataset return — dangerous behavior।

TC-FILTER-018: minPrice > maxPrice

Query: minPrice=1000&maxPrice=100

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "minPrice cannot be greater than maxPrice." Empty result without error message — confusing UX।

TC-FILTER-019: Negative Price Value

Query: minPrice=-100

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — negative price filter rejected। Business logic-এ negative price invalid।

TC-FILTER-020: Invalid Date Format

Query: from=31-01-2026 (wrong format)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with format hint — "Use YYYY-MM-DD"। Invalid date silently ignore acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-021: from Date After to Date

Query: from=2026-06-30&to=2026-01-01

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "Start date must be before end date."

TC-FILTER-022: Invalid Enum Value

Query: status=deleted (not in allowed enum)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with allowed values list — silent pass করে wrong data return acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-023: Empty Filter Value

Query: category=

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request অথবা filter ignored (documented) — empty string match করে unexpected result acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-024: Unknown Query Parameter

Query: unknownParam=xyz&category=books

Expected Result: 200, unknown param ignored — অথবা strict mode-এ 400। Behavior documented এবং consistent।

---

Security Test Cases

Filter parameter user-controlled — injection এবং authorization bypass-এর primary attack surface।

TC-FILTER-025: SQL Injection via Category

Query: category='; DROP TABLE products; --

Expected Result: Sanitized — plain text filter value হিসেবে treat। Database error, data leak, বা 500 acceptable নয়। Parameterized query verify।

TC-FILTER-026: NoSQL Injection

Query: category={"$gt":""}

Expected Result: Plain text হিসেবে treat — query operator execute হবে না। Full collection dump acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-027: LDAP Injection

Query: search=*)(uid=*))(|(uid=*

Expected Result: Escaped/rejected — unauthorized directory data access হবে না।

TC-FILTER-028: Filter Bypass — Sensitive Data Leak

Scenario: User role=customer, filter=category=internal

Expected Result: 403 Forbidden — internal category customer-এর কাছে expose হবে না। Filter parameter দিয়ে restricted data access block।

TC-FILTER-029: Cross-Tenant Filter Bypass

Scenario: Multi-tenant SaaS — Tenant A user Tenant B-এর tenantId parameter inject করে request।

Expected Result: 403 Forbidden — implicit tenant filter server-side enforce। Client-supplied tenantId trust করা acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-030: Mass Assignment via Filter

Query: isAdmin=true&category=books

Expected Result: isAdmin filter ignore — non-admin user admin-only field দিয়ে filter করতে পারবে না। Privilege escalation block।

---

Boundary & Edge Case Tests

TC-FILTER-031: Price Boundary — Exact minPrice

Query: minPrice=500 (product exists with price exactly 500)

Expected Result: Price=500 item include (inclusive boundary) — spec অনুযায়ী। Off-by-one boundary bug common।

TC-FILTER-032: Price Boundary — Exact maxPrice

Query: maxPrice=999.99

Expected Result: Price=999.99 item include। Floating point comparison accurate — 999.989999 exclude, 999.99 include।

TC-FILTER-033: Empty Result Set

Query: category=electronics&minPrice=999999

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array, total: 0। Error throw হবে না। UI-তে "No results found" message appropriate।

TC-FILTER-034: Single Matching Record

Query: Unique filter combination যেটা exactly 1 item match করে

Expected Result: 1 item return, total: 1। Pagination metadata correct — totalPages: 1।

TC-FILTER-035: Filter on NULL Field Values

Scenario: কিছু product-এ brand null। Query: brand=samsung

Expected Result: Null brand item exclude — null match করে leak হবে না। Null-specific filter (brand=null) documented থাকলে verify।

TC-FILTER-036: Special Characters in Filter Value

Query: search=O'Connor&category=books

Expected Result: Apostrophe handle — server error বা SQL break হবে না। Correct filtered result।

TC-FILTER-037: Unicode / Bengali Filter Value

Query: category=ইলেকট্রনিক্স (Bengali category name)

Expected Result: UTF-8 handle — corrupt encoding বা 500 error হবে না। Match behavior documented।

TC-FILTER-038: Very Long Filter Value

Query: search= [500 character string]

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request or truncated — server crash বা timeout acceptable নয়।

---

Data Accuracy & Filter Leak Tests

Filtering-এর সবচেয়ে critical bug — filter leak: filter apply করলেও unauthorized data mixed result-এ আসা।

TC-FILTER-039: Spot-Check Individual Item Verification

Steps:

  1. Apply filter: category=electronics
  2. Response থেকে 5 random item pick করুন
  3. প্রতিটি item individually GET /api/products/{id} দিয়ে fetch করুন

Expected Result: প্রতিটি individually fetched item-এ category = "electronics"। List endpoint এবং detail endpoint data consistent।

TC-FILTER-040: Total Count Accuracy

Steps: Filter apply করে metadata total note করুন। All pages fetch করে actual item count compare করুন।

Expected Result: Sum of all page items == total metadata। Off-by-one বা duplicate count bug catch।

TC-FILTER-041: Filter Consistency Across Pages

Steps: category=electronics, pageSize=10 — সব page fetch করুন।

Expected Result: প্রতিটি page-এ 100% electronics item। Page 3-তে suddenly books item — filter leak bug।

TC-FILTER-042: Filter vs Unfiltered Count

Steps: No filter total count vs category=electronics total compare।

Expected Result: Filtered total <= unfiltered total। Filtered total বেশি — impossible, bug indicator।

TC-FILTER-043: Database-Level Verification

Steps: Same filter criteria দিয়ে database-এ manual query run করুন (read-only access)। API result count compare।

Expected Result: API count == database count। Mismatch হলে backend query logic bug — JOIN, soft delete, cache issue investigate।

---

UI & API Consistency Tests

TC-FILTER-044: UI Filter Selection Matches API Call

Steps: UI-তে "Electronics" category select করুন। Network tab-এ API request inspect করুন।

Expected Result: API call-এ category=electronics (বা documented slug)। UI selection এবং API parameter sync।

TC-FILTER-045: Multiple UI Filters — Parameter Mapping

Steps: Category + Price range + Status — তিনটি UI filter একসাথে apply করুন।

Expected Result: API call-এ তিনটি parameter correctly mapped। Missing parameter — filter silently ignore bug।

TC-FILTER-046: Clear / Reset Filters

Steps: Filter apply করুন, "Clear All" click করুন।

Expected Result: API call without filter parameters — full dataset return। Previous filter state persist হবে না। URL query params clear।

TC-FILTER-047: Filter Persistence in URL

Steps: Filter apply করুন, page refresh করুন।

Expected Result: URL-এ filter params persist — same filtered result reload। Shareable filtered URL কাজ করে।

TC-FILTER-048: Filter Chip / Badge Display

Expected Result: Active filter UI-তে visible — user কোন filter apply করেছে জানতে পারবে। Chip remove করলে corresponding API param remove।

---

Facet Count & Aggregation Tests

Many e-commerce এবং listing API filter option-এর পাশাপাশি count return করে — "Electronics (45)", "Books (23)"।

TC-FILTER-049: Facet Count Accuracy

Endpoint: GET /api/products/facets বা filter response-এ embedded counts

Expected Result: category=electronics count == actual electronics item count database-এ। Stale count misleading UX।

TC-FILTER-050: Facet Count Updates with Active Filter

Scenario: status=active filter active — category facet counts reflect active items only

Expected Result: Facet counts filtered context-এ accurate — inactive item count include হবে না active filter-এ।

TC-FILTER-051: Zero Count Facet Hidden or Disabled

Expected Result: Count=0 category UI-তে hidden অথবা disabled — click করলে empty result avoid। UX policy documented।

---

Performance & Scalability Tests

TC-FILTER-052: Filter Response Time — Indexed Field

Query: category=electronics (indexed column)

Expected Result: Response < 200ms (SLA adjust করুন)। Database index filter column-এ exists verify।

TC-FILTER-053: Filter Response Time — Non-Indexed Field

Query: customField=value (no index)

Expected Result: Acceptable performance — extreme slow query-তে timeout gracefully, hung request নয়।

TC-FILTER-054: Complex Multi-Filter Query

Query: 5+ filter parameter simultaneously

Expected Result: Response within SLA। Query plan efficient — full table scan avoid where possible।

TC-FILTER-055: Concurrent Filter Requests

Steps: 20 user different filter combination-এ simultaneously request।

Expected Result: প্রতিটি user correct filtered result — cross-request data contamination হবে না।

---

Test Automation Strategy

Filtering manually verify tedious — automation efficient regression catch করে।

  • Assertion Loop: Response array iterate করে প্রতিটি item filter condition satisfy verify — single leak instant detect।
  • Count Validation: API total vs paginated sum compare — automated count mismatch catch।
  • Database Cross-Check: Test environment-এ API result vs direct DB query — data accuracy automated verify।
  • Negative Test Suite: Invalid input, injection payload — automated security regression।
  • UI + API Sync: Playwright/Cypress-এ filter select → network intercept → parameter match assert।

Pro Tip:

Filtering test suite-এ TC-FILTER-001 (category leak check) এবং TC-FILTER-041 (cross-page consistency) — এ দুটোকে highest priority দিন। Production-এ filter leak user trust destroy করে — আর spot-check (TC-FILTER-039) manual regression-এ every release-এ run করুন।

---

Bug Report Template — Filtering Issues

Filtering bug report করার সময় developer reproduce করতে এই information দিন:

  • Exact API URL with all filter, sort, pagination parameters
  • Expected: filtered item count এবং sample item IDs
  • Actual: leaked item ID যেটা filter condition violate করে
  • Leaked item-এর actual field value (e.g., category=books when filter=electronics)
  • UI screenshot + Network tab request/response
  • User role used during test
  • Database count for same filter criteria (if accessible)
---

পরিশেষে

Filtering Testing-কে "filter দিলাম data আসল" level-এ রাখলে Production-এ silent data bug inevitable। সবচেয়ে critical তিনটি area:

  1. Filter leak prevention — returned data প্রতিটি item-এ condition satisfy
  2. Multi-filter AND/OR logic — combination behavior documented এবং verified
  3. Security — injection, cross-tenant bypass, role-based filter enforcement

এই 55টি test case functional validation, security, boundary, UI consistency, performance — সব dimension cover করে। Release-এর আগে minimum TC-FILTER-001, TC-FILTER-010 (multi-filter AND), TC-FILTER-039 (spot-check), এবং TC-FILTER-041 (cross-page) mandatory regression suite-এ রাখুন।

Tags: #FilteringTesting #APITesting #QueryParams #FilterLeak #SecurityTesting #DataAccuracy #Pagination #QA #SQA

Query: status=active&minPrice=500&sort=createdAt&order=desc&page=1&pageSize=20

Expected Result: Active, price >= 500, newest first, first 20 item। Metadata total filtered total match।

Negative & Validation Test Cases

TC-FILTER-016: Non-Existent Category

Query: category=nonexistentcategory

Expected Result: Status 200 OK, empty array, total: 0। 404 বা 500 acceptable নয় — empty filter result error নয়।

TC-FILTER-017: Invalid Numeric Filter Value

Query: minPrice=abc

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "minPrice must be a number." Silent ignore করে full dataset return — dangerous behavior।

TC-FILTER-018: minPrice > maxPrice

Query: minPrice=1000&maxPrice=100

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "minPrice cannot be greater than maxPrice." Empty result without error message — confusing UX।

TC-FILTER-019: Negative Price Value

Query: minPrice=-100

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — negative price filter rejected। Business logic-এ negative price invalid।

TC-FILTER-020: Invalid Date Format

Query: from=31-01-2026 (wrong format)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with format hint — "Use YYYY-MM-DD"। Invalid date silently ignore acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-021: from Date After to Date

Query: from=2026-06-30&to=2026-01-01

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "Start date must be before end date."

TC-FILTER-022: Invalid Enum Value

Query: status=deleted (not in allowed enum)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with allowed values list — silent pass করে wrong data return acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-023: Empty Filter Value

Query: category=

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request অথবা filter ignored (documented) — empty string match করে unexpected result acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-024: Unknown Query Parameter

Query: unknownParam=xyz&category=books

Expected Result: 200, unknown param ignored — অথবা strict mode-এ 400। Behavior documented এবং consistent।

Security Test Cases

Filter parameter user-controlled — injection এবং authorization bypass-এর primary attack surface।

TC-FILTER-025: SQL Injection via Category

Query: category='; DROP TABLE products; --

Expected Result: Sanitized — plain text filter value হিসেবে treat। Database error, data leak, বা 500 acceptable নয়। Parameterized query verify।

TC-FILTER-026: NoSQL Injection

Query: category={"$gt":""}

Expected Result: Plain text হিসেবে treat — query operator execute হবে না। Full collection dump acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-027: LDAP Injection

Query: search=*)(uid=*))(|(uid=*

Expected Result: Escaped/rejected — unauthorized directory data access হবে না।

TC-FILTER-028: Filter Bypass — Sensitive Data Leak

Scenario: User role=customer, filter=category=internal

Expected Result: 403 Forbidden — internal category customer-এর কাছে expose হবে না। Filter parameter দিয়ে restricted data access block।

TC-FILTER-029: Cross-Tenant Filter Bypass

Scenario: Multi-tenant SaaS — Tenant A user Tenant B-এর tenantId parameter inject করে request।

Expected Result: 403 Forbidden — implicit tenant filter server-side enforce। Client-supplied tenantId trust করা acceptable নয়।

TC-FILTER-030: Mass Assignment via Filter

Query: isAdmin=true&category=books

Expected Result: isAdmin filter ignore — non-admin user admin-only field দিয়ে filter করতে পারবে না। Privilege escalation block।

Boundary & Edge Case Tests

TC-FILTER-031: Price Boundary — Exact minPrice

Query: minPrice=500 (product exists with price exactly 500)

Expected Result: Price=500 item include (inclusive boundary) — spec অনুযায়ী। Off-by-one boundary bug common।

TC-FILTER-032: Price Boundary — Exact maxPrice

Query: maxPrice=999.99

Expected Result: Price=999.99 item include। Floating point comparison accurate — 999.989999 exclude, 999.99 include।

TC-FILTER-033: Empty Result Set

Query: category=electronics&minPrice=999999

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array, total: 0। Error throw হবে না। UI-তে "No results found" message appropriate।

TC-FILTER-034: Single Matching Record

Query: Unique filter combination যেটা exactly 1 item match করে

Expected Result: 1 item return, total: 1। Pagination metadata correct — totalPages: 1।

TC-FILTER-035: Filter on NULL Field Values

Scenario: কিছু product-এ brand null। Query: brand=samsung

Expected Result: Null brand item exclude — null match করে leak হবে না। Null-specific filter (brand=null) documented থাকলে verify।

TC-FILTER-036: Special Characters in Filter Value

Query: search=O'Connor&category=books

Expected Result: Apostrophe handle — server error বা SQL break হবে না। Correct filtered result।

TC-FILTER-037: Unicode / Bengali Filter Value

Query: category=ইলেকট্রনিক্স (Bengali category name)

Expected Result: UTF-8 handle — corrupt encoding বা 500 error হবে না। Match behavior documented।

TC-FILTER-038: Very Long Filter Value

Query: search= [500 character string]

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request or truncated — server crash বা timeout acceptable নয়।

Data Accuracy & Filter Leak Tests

Filtering-এর সবচেয়ে critical bug — filter leak: filter apply করলেও unauthorized data mixed result-এ আসা।

TC-FILTER-039: Spot-Check Individual Item Verification

Steps:

  1. Apply filter: category=electronics
  2. Response থেকে 5 random item pick করুন
  3. প্রতিটি item individually GET /api/products/{id} দিয়ে fetch করুন

Expected Result: প্রতিটি individually fetched item-এ category = "electronics"। List endpoint এবং detail endpoint data consistent।

TC-FILTER-040: Total Count Accuracy

Steps: Filter apply করে metadata total note করুন। All pages fetch করে actual item count compare করুন।

Expected Result: Sum of all page items == total metadata। Off-by-one বা duplicate count bug catch।

TC-FILTER-041: Filter Consistency Across Pages

Steps: category=electronics, pageSize=10 — সব page fetch করুন।

Expected Result: প্রতিটি page-এ 100% electronics item। Page 3-তে suddenly books item — filter leak bug।

TC-FILTER-042: Filter vs Unfiltered Count

Steps: No filter total count vs category=electronics total compare।

Expected Result: Filtered total <= unfiltered total। Filtered total বেশি — impossible, bug indicator।

TC-FILTER-043: Database-Level Verification

Steps: Same filter criteria দিয়ে database-এ manual query run করুন (read-only access)। API result count compare।

Expected Result: API count == database count। Mismatch হলে backend query logic bug — JOIN, soft delete, cache issue investigate।

UI & API Consistency Tests

TC-FILTER-044: UI Filter Selection Matches API Call

Steps: UI-তে "Electronics" category select করুন। Network tab-এ API request inspect করুন।

Expected Result: API call-এ category=electronics (বা documented slug)। UI selection এবং API parameter sync।

TC-FILTER-045: Multiple UI Filters — Parameter Mapping

Steps: Category + Price range + Status — তিনটি UI filter একসাথে apply করুন।

Expected Result: API call-এ তিনটি parameter correctly mapped। Missing parameter — filter silently ignore bug।

TC-FILTER-046: Clear / Reset Filters

Steps: Filter apply করুন, "Clear All" click করুন।

Expected Result: API call without filter parameters — full dataset return। Previous filter state persist হবে না। URL query params clear।

TC-FILTER-047: Filter Persistence in URL

Steps: Filter apply করুন, page refresh করুন।

Expected Result: URL-এ filter params persist — same filtered result reload। Shareable filtered URL কাজ করে।

TC-FILTER-048: Filter Chip / Badge Display

Expected Result: Active filter UI-তে visible — user কোন filter apply করেছে জানতে পারবে। Chip remove করলে corresponding API param remove।

Performance & Scalability Tests

TC-FILTER-052: Filter Response Time — Indexed Field

Test Automation Strategy

Filtering manually verify tedious — automation efficient regression catch করে।

  • Assertion Loop: Response array iterate করে প্রতিটি item filter condition satisfy verify — single leak instant detect।
  • Count Validation: API total vs paginated sum compare — automated count mismatch catch।
  • Database Cross-Check: Test environment-এ API result vs direct DB query — data accuracy automated verify।
  • Negative Test Suite: Invalid input, injection payload — automated security regression।
  • UI + API Sync: Playwright/Cypress-এ filter select → network intercept → parameter match assert।

Pro Tip:

Filtering test suite-এ TC-FILTER-001 (category leak check) এবং TC-FILTER-041 (cross-page consistency) — এ দুটোকে highest priority দিন। Production-এ filter leak user trust destroy করে — আর spot-check (TC-FILTER-039) manual regression-এ every release-এ run করুন।

Bug Report Template — Filtering Issues

Filtering bug report করার সময় developer reproduce করতে এই information দিন:

  • Exact API URL with all filter, sort, pagination parameters
  • Expected: filtered item count এবং sample item IDs
  • Actual: leaked item ID যেটা filter condition violate করে
  • Leaked item-এর actual field value (e.g., category=books when filter=electronics)
  • UI screenshot + Network tab request/response
  • User role used during test
  • Database count for same filter criteria (if accessible)
---

Conclusion

Filtering Testing-কে "filter দিলাম data আসল" level-এ রাখলে Production-এ silent data bug inevitable। সবচেয়ে critical তিনটি area:

  1. Filter leak prevention — returned data প্রতিটি item-এ condition satisfy
  2. Multi-filter AND/OR logic — combination behavior documented এবং verified
  3. Security — injection, cross-tenant bypass, role-based filter enforcement

এই 55টি test case functional validation, security, boundary, UI consistency, performance — সব dimension cover করে। Release-এর আগে minimum TC-FILTER-001, TC-FILTER-010 (multi-filter AND), TC-FILTER-039 (spot-check), এবং TC-FILTER-041 (cross-page) mandatory regression suite-এ রাখুন।
